Pinia import a store.description: Import a Pinia store and instantiate it.

Pinia import storeToRefs().description:
`storeToRefs()` keeps state and getters reactive when destructured.
Actions are plain functions - destructure them straight off the store.

Pinia import mapState().description:
Options API: map state and getters as readonly computed properties.
You can also pass an object to rename, or a function to compute from the store.

Pinia import mapActions().description: Options API: map actions as methods on the component.

Pinia import mapWritableState().description:
Options API: map state as writable computed properties (e.g. for `v-model`).
Unlike `mapState()`, it cannot take a function.

Pinia import mapStores().description:
Options API: map whole stores as computed properties.
The store id gets a `Store` suffix - `useCartStore` becomes `this.cartStore`.

Pinia mapState().description: Options API: map state and getters as readonly computed properties.

Pinia mapActions().description: Options API: map actions as methods on the component.

Pinia mapWritableState().description: Options API: map state as writable computed properties (e.g. for `v-model`).

Pinia mapStores().description:
Options API: map whole stores as computed properties.
Takes store definitions as a spread argument, unlike the other map helpers.

Pinia setMapStoreSuffix().description:
Change (or remove, with an empty string) the suffix `mapStores()` appends.
Call it once, before any store is created.

Pinia store.$patch() with a function.description:
Mutate several state properties at once. Use the function form for collections
(push / splice / filter) - the object form cannot express them. Must be synchronous.

Pinia store.$patch() with an object.description:
Apply a partial state object. Grouped into a single devtools entry,
unlike a series of separate assignments.

Pinia store.$state.description: Replace the whole state of one store (internally calls `$patch()`).

Pinia store.$reset().description:
Reset state to its initial value. Built in for Option Stores only -
Setup Stores must return their own `$reset()`.

Pinia store.$subscribe().description:
Watch state changes. `mutation.type` is 'direct' | 'patch object' | 'patch function'.
Pass `{ detached: true }` to survive the component unmounting.

Pinia store.$onAction().description:
Watch actions. `after()` runs on success, `onError()` on throw or rejection.
Bound to the current component unless you pass `true` as the second argument.

Pinia store.$dispose().description:
Stop all effects and subscriptions of one store.
The state remains in the pinia instance - `delete pinia.state.value[store.$id]` to drop it.

Pinia acceptHMRUpdate().description:
Hot Module Replacement for a store (Vite). Add `acceptHMRUpdate` to the `pinia` import
and put this at the end of the store file. Without it, editing a store reloads the page.

Pinia setActivePinia().description:
Make a pinia instance active so stores can be used with no app mounted
(tests, scripts, SSR request scope).

Pinia getActivePinia().description: Read the currently active pinia instance. Returns `undefined` if none is active.

Pinia disposePinia().description:
Dispose an entire pinia instance: stops every store and releases its state.
Useful between SSR requests and in tests.

Pinia skipHydrate().description:
SSR: mark state as non-hydratable so the server payload does not overwrite it
(browser-only objects, localStorage-backed refs).

Pinia shouldHydrate().description:
Check whether a value is hydratable, i.e. not marked with `skipHydrate()`.
Used when writing custom serialization in a plugin.

Pinia pinia.use().description:
Register a plugin. Must run before `app.use(pinia)`.
Whatever the plugin returns is added to every store and shown in devtools.

Pinia pinia.state.value.description:
The root state of every store. Serialize it on the SSR server and assign it back
on the client before mounting. Assign `{}` to reset the whole app.

body: // wrapped so \$onAction also fires when called from inside the store
Pinia Setup Store action() helper.description:
The setup function receives a `{ action }` helper (Pinia 4).
Wrapping a function with it makes `$onAction` fire even when the action is called
from within the store itself. Rarely needed in application code.
